item.title: Lauter Waterfall, Swabian Alb
item.description: Drag to look around 🌿💧 Under a green canopy on the Lauter stream in the Swabian Alb, Baden-Württemberg, Germany — water rushes over mossy rocks in soft, dappled light. This panorama began as a high-dynamic-range 360° capture and was tone-mapped so it can be shared as a Facebook 360 photo. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0 https://polyhaven.com/a/lauter_waterfall #Lauter #SwabianAlb #Germany #Waterfall #360Photo #ForestStream #Nature

item.title: Sihlwasserfall, Zurich
item.description: Drag to look around 💧🌍 A small waterfall with a big-city address: the Sihlwasserfall, where the river Sihl tumbles over rocks in Zurich, Switzerland. The viewpoint sits right beside the Sihlpromenade, the popular walking and cycling path that follows the river through the city. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Daniel Kraft, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — captured May 2021 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sihlwasserfall_panosphere_20210531.jpg #Zurich #Sihl #Waterfall #Switzerland #360Photo #CityNature #RiverWalk

item.title: Lustgarten at night, Berlin
item.description: Drag to look around 🌙🌍 Night on the Lustgarten, on Berlin's Museum Island. The Altes Museum and the Berlin Cathedral stand floodlit across the square — and beside them, in this March 2016 panorama, the Berlin Palace was still a construction site; it has since been completed as the Humboldt Forum. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Ansgar Koreng, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — captured March 2016 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lustgarten,_Berlin-Mitte,_Panorama,_Nacht,_160316,_ako.jpg #Berlin #Lustgarten #MuseumIsland #BerlinCathedral #CityNight #360Photo #Germany

item.title: The Bund at night, Shanghai
item.description: Drag to look around 🌃🌍 The Bund at night, Shanghai. From the historic waterfront promenade on the Huangpu River, the neon towers of Pudong blaze across the water, doubling themselves in the river below. item.title: Ala Archa National Park gorge
item.description: Drag to look around 🏞️🌍 Ala Archa National Park, in the Tian Shan mountains about 40 km south of Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. Established in 1976, the park wraps around the gorge of the Ala-Archa River and climbs from about 1,500 m at the entrance to 4,895 m at Semenov-Tian-Shansky Peak, past more than 20 glaciers. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Nikolai Bulykin, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — captured August 2023 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B0-%D0%90%D1%80%D1%87%D0%B0,_%D1%81%D1%84%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B0.jpg #AlaArcha #Kyrgyzstan #TianShan #Bishkek #NationalPark #360Photo #CentralAsia

item.title: Mount Nuolja trail, Abisko National Park
item.description: Drag to look around 🌲🌍 A summer trail around Mount Nuolja in Abisko National Park, Swedish Lapland. Founded in 1909, Abisko is one of Sweden's very first national parks — 77 km² of Arctic mountain landscape above the Arctic Circle, next to the great lake Torneträsk. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Jojoo64, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — captured July 2020 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Track_Abisko_National_Park_360_Degree.jpg #Abisko #SwedishLapland #NationalPark #Arctic #360Photo #Sweden #Nuolja

item.title: Athabasca Glacier, Jasper National Park
item.description: Drag to look around 🧊🌍 The Athabasca Glacier flows about 6 km down from the Columbia Icefield — at 325 km², the largest icefield in the North American Rockies — here in Jasper National Park, Alberta, Canada. The ice sits right beside the Icefields Parkway, one of the most scenic drives on Earth. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Martin Kraft, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 — captured October 2013 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MK04463-72_Athabasca_Glacier_Icefields_Parkway_(Jasper_NP)_spherical.jpg #AthabascaGlacier #JasperNationalPark #ColumbiaIcefield #IcefieldsParkway #Canada #360Photo #CanadianRockies

item.title: Shymbulak ski resort from above
item.description: Drag to look around 🎿🌍 Winter above Shymbulak, the ski resort in the Trans-Ili Alatau mountains just outside Almaty, Kazakhstan. The lifts climb from the resort base at 2,260 m all the way to Talgar Pass at 3,200 m — this panorama was taken from above the slopes, looking out over the northern Tian Shan. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Nikolai Bulykin, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — captured January 2023 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8B,_%D0%A8%D1%8B%D0%BC%D0%B1%D1%83%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%BA,_%D1%81%D1%84%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B0.jpg #Shymbulak #Almaty #Kazakhstan #TianShan #360Photo #SkiResort #SnowMountain

item.title: Piz Ela summit
item.description: Drag to look around 🏔️🌍 You are standing on the summit of Piz Ela, 3,339 m above Bergün in the Albula Alps of Graubünden, Switzerland. The peak sits at the very heart of Parc Ela nature park, and on a clear day the view runs across range after range of the Swiss Alps. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Capricorn4049, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — captured July 2022 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piz_Ela_Spherical_Panorama.jpg #PizEla #ParcEla #AlbulaAlps #Graubunden #360Photo #SwissAlps #Switzerland

item.title: Mittler Wissberg winter summit
item.description: Drag to look around 🏔️❄️ This is the winter summit of Mittler Wissberg (2,980 m) in the Avers–Surses area of Graubünden, Switzerland — a quiet corner of the Swiss Alps that ski tourers climb from the valley below. From the top, snow-covered ridges roll away in every direction. Tap the photo and drag — or move your phone — to explore the full 360° view. 📸 Panorama by Capricorn4049, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 — captured April 2024 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mittler_Wissberg_(winter_peak)_Spherical_Panorama.jpg #MittlerWissberg #Graubunden #SwissAlps #360Photo #SnowMountain #Switzerland #WinterAlps
